questions.stem: Pointing to a man, a woman said, "His mother is the only daughter of my mother." How is the woman related to the man?

If P + Q means P is the father of Q, P - Q means P is the sister of Q, and P x Q means P is the mother of Q, what does A + B - C mean?
choices: A is the uncle of C
A is the father of C
A is the grandfather of C
C is the aunt of A
